region.widthRule: 100% of the page content box: 24px page padding + 1200px max width + 1px region frame, reproduced identically on both sides

exclusions.reason: The docs page renders a usage code block under the preview; the product region ends at [data-slot="pdf-viewer"].
Docs preview card (rounded border, page margins) wraps the product component; the harness reproduces only its box metrics so both regions receive the same width.
Demo-only page header, sample selector, runtime-policy panel, status grid and diagnostics list; the upstream docs page has none of them.
Demo frame (1px border, radius, overflow) that wraps the viewer; only its box metrics are reproduced on the reference side.

differences.impact: The shipped route shows a 160px thumbnail sidebar the reference does not have; the capture clicks the toggle so the remaining chrome is comparable.

differences.evidence: packages/vue-pdf/src/components/PdfViewer.vue:1952 renders `[data-testid="pdf-status-bar"]` when `show-status-bar` is set; the upstream viewer has no status bar.
differences.impact: The demo page turns it on, so the demo route is ~28px shorter in the page viewport than upstream. The capture state sets `show-status-bar=false`.

differences.evidence: packages/vue-pdf/src/components/PdfViewer.vue:2008 `--pdf-canvas-bg: #e5e7eb`; upstream paints the page area with `bg-muted/30` (apps/v4/components/extend/pdf-viewer.tsx:579).
differences.impact: The whole page canvas is visibly darker than the reference in light mode (and darker still in dark mode); this is the largest source of chrome-only pixel diff.

differences.evidence: packages/vue-pdf/src/components/PdfViewer.vue:2024 `--pdf-page-filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg)`; the upstream viewer renders page rasters unmodified in dark mode.
differences.impact: Dark-mode page content is inverted on our side, so the dark route can never match the reference pixels.

differences.evidence: apps/v4/components/extend/pdf-viewer.tsx:2644 applies `blur-[0.35px]` to the page raster ``; packages/vue-pdf/src/components/PdfViewer.vue:2080 `.pdf-page-image` renders unblurred.
differences.impact: Every glyph edge differs by a few channel levels, which pushes diff pixels far above the 0.1% budget even when geometry matches.

differences.evidence: packages/vue-pdf/src/components/PdfViewer.vue:2122 `@container pdf-viewer (max-width: 760px) { .pdf-frame-wrap { padding: 12px } }`; upstream `pdf-viewer.tsx` scroll content keeps `padding: 24px` at every width.
differences.impact: At 768 and 390 the page frame starts 12px up/left of the reference (landmark page1 Δ -12px), which also changes how much of page 1 is visible.

differences.evidence: Reference page frame is 595.266 x 841.875 CSS px, ours 595 x 841.281 (capture report `geometry.landmarks.page1`).
differences.impact: Sub-pixel rounding of the zoom-1 page size; contributes to raster diff but stays under the 1px landmark budget.
